audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] and packet levelChart agree on Mel/Mel/Viktor/Viktor/Viktor/Mel/Viktor; several phase whys argue the wrong side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer uses fabricated/old ability names 'Death Ray' and 'Chaos Storm' throughout, and claims Arcane Storm silences Mel — Riot's text says it damages, follows and interrupts channels, no silence.
audit.why: Kit file: Q Siphon Power (9/8/7/6/5s, shield + auto reset), W Gravity Field (17-13s, slow-then-stun zone), E Hextech Ray (12-8s, 525 cast, projectile — Rebuttal-reflectable), R Arcane Storm (120/100/80s, movable damage zone). Gravity Field and Arcane Storm are zones, not projectiles — they land through Rebuttal.
audit.corrected: All names fixed to Hextech Ray / Arcane Storm; silence claims replaced with what R actually does; projectile-vs-zone distinction stated in dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: Trading rules (free volleys while his spells are hostage, never trade in W downtime) hold once names are fixed.
Real numbers exist in the kit: Gravity Field 17s rank 1, Hextech Ray 12s rank 1, Mel W 38s rank 1.
Wave guidance (volley-thinned slow push behind W) is sound and specific.
Roam/jungle text is specific to reflect and snare setup.
Rune page standard for Mel poke lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kit flags Viktor R as an interruptible channel and missing-interactions suggests Solar Snare cancels it, but Riot's own description reads as a movable storm, not a channel.
audit.why: Flag contradicts description; per calibration rule I trust the description and did not assert the cancel.
No patch-26.15 movement found in the brief; no claim made.

edits.before: Viktor wins by landing Gravity Field, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Viktor wins by shoving you off waves with Hextech Ray, eating your poke with Siphon Power's shield, and stunning your all-in.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. It governs your forward steps. - W Rebuttal spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Viktor Gravity Field: 17s at rank 1, 13s max — the stun zone owns every all-in; walk out the moment it drops or fight in the window after it. - Your Rebuttal is 38s early: spent on poke it's a death you scheduled. - Hextech Ray is 12s at rank 1 — chip in its downtime.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
